# After the Hall of Fame: Lustrous Pearl

Becoming Champion opens the rest of the game. This page also has the one-time Pokémon of the story and the event Pokémon. Everything here reads from the game's scripts.

## What the Hall of Fame opens

- **The National Pokédex.** Go to Professor Rowan's lab in Sandgem: you get it once you're the Champion, without needing to have seen every Sinnoh Pokémon. Professor Oak also gives you a Poké Radar there, but this game has no Poké Radar patches.
- **The ship to the Battle Zone.** Talk to the sailor at the Snowpoint City dock.
- **Pal Park's rooms.** See [Pal Park](ramanas-park-pearl.md).
- **The event gifts.** See [the deliveryman](#the-deliveryman-and-the-event-pokémon).
- **The Spring Path** on Mt. Coronet, to Sendoff Spring and Turnback Cave, once you have the National Pokédex.
- **More Pokémon** in the Great Marsh, the Trophy Garden and [the Hideaways](underground.md), plus daily Mysterious Shards and fossils there.

## The Battle Zone

The ship takes you to the Fight Area. From there Routes 225-230, the Survival Area and the Resort Area are on foot and on the water.

### Your rival

Barry waits in the Fight Area: one battle a day. After 20 Hall of Fame entries his team is 10 levels higher. Teams: [trainers](trainers-pearl.md).

### The Battle Tower

In the Battle Park, next to the Fight Area. Win seven battles in a row to clear a set.

- **Modes:** Single, Double, and Multi with a partner you pick from Cheryl, Riley, Marley, Buck and Mira. Wi-Fi and wireless battles are closed.
- **Levels:** every Pokémon battles at exactly level 50.
- **Battle Points for a cleared set:** 3, 3, 4, 4, 5, 5, then 7 a set from the seventh on.
- **Palmer** appears at the end of the third and the seventh sets of Single Battles (battles 21 and 49). Beating him pays 20 BP.
- Battle Points go into one purse with the World Tournament's.

### The Pokémon World Tournament

The east door of the Exchange Service Corner's building. The Sinnoh Leaders tournament opens with the Hall of Fame; the left desk's tournaments are open from the start. Its Battle Point shops share the Tower's BP. Some of the lobby's text still talks of Unova ([known issues](known-issues.md)).

## Stark Mountain

North of Route 227, past the Battle Zone. Rock Climb is needed on the way up. Inside, Buck joins you as a partner, then takes the Magma Stone. Visit him at his grandfather's house in the Survival Area; then, with the National Pokédex, **Heatran** (level 70) is in the last room. Knock it out and it's gone for good; run, and it's back after your next Hall of Fame entry.

## Snowpoint Temple

Candice lets you in once you're the Champion and have the National Pokédex. At the bottom (B5F) stands a statue: with Regirock, Regice and Registeel in your party, **Regigigas** (level 70) wakes up. The three Regis come from [Pal Park's Discovery Room](ramanas-park-pearl.md). As with Heatran, knocked out is gone for good, and if you run it's back after your next Hall of Fame entry.

## Turnback Cave

Through the Spring Path on Mt. Coronet and Sendoff Spring. Every room has four doors. A room you walk into leads on to another room, and the way you came in leads back to the entrance:

- A door has a 25% chance to lead to a room with a pillar. Find three pillar rooms to reach Giratina's room.
- After 30 rooms, every door leads back to the entrance.
- Continuing a saved game makes every door lead back to the entrance.
- **Giratina** (level 70) is in the last room. Catching it or knocking it out opens the [Distortion Room](ramanas-park-pearl.md). Run, and it stays.
- The wild Pokémon level rises with the pillars you've seen: see [Turnback Cave](wild-pokemon-pearl.md#turnback-cave-no-pillar-seen-yet).

## Fullmoon and Newmoon Islands

**Fullmoon Island:** after the Hall of Fame, with the National Pokédex, visit the sailor's house in Canalave City: his son has nightmares. The sailor at the harbour then takes you to Fullmoon Island. Cresselia flies off and starts [roaming](#roaming-pokémon). Pick up the Lunar Wing and bring it to the boy.

**Newmoon Island:** once the boy has woken up, and with the Member Card from [the deliveryman](#the-deliveryman-and-the-event-pokémon), sleep at Canalave's Harbor Inn. In the dream you reach Newmoon Island: **Darkrai** (level 40). Afterwards the sailor can sail there.

## Roaming Pokémon

| Pokémon | Level | Starts |
|---|---|---|
| Mesprit | 50 | when Spear Pillar is over: meet it in Verity Cavern |
| Cresselia | 50 | after Fullmoon Island |

A roamer moves whenever you walk into another area: to a neighbouring one, or one time in 16 anywhere. Fly, Teleport and continuing a saved game send it anywhere. In its area, half of your wild battles there are the roamer. It keeps its HP and status from battle to battle and runs when it can. Once knocked out or caught it doesn't come back. The Pokédex's AREA page and the Pokétch's Marking Map show where it is.

Places: Fuego Ironworks (outside), Route 201, Route 202, Route 203, Route 204 North, Route 204 South, Route 205 North, Route 205 South, Route 206, Route 207, Route 208, Route 209, Route 210 North, Route 210 South, Route 211 East, Route 211 West, Route 212 North, Route 212 South, Route 213, Route 214, Route 215, Route 216, Route 217, Route 218, Route 219, Route 220, Route 221, Route 222, Valley Windworks.

## The deliveryman and the event Pokémon

After the Hall of Fame a deliveryman stands in every Poké Mart. Talk to him for one gift each time, in this order:

| # | Gift | Opens |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Member Card | [Newmoon Island](#fullmoon-and-newmoon-islands) and Darkrai |
| 2 | Oak's Letter | Route 224: with the National Pokédex, show it to Professor Oak there and name who you want to thank at the stone tablet. The Seabreak Path opens to Flower Paradise: **Shaymin** (level 30). If it isn't caught it's back next visit |
| 3 | Azure Flute | Go to Spear Pillar with it, with the National Pokédex: the flute sounds and takes you to the Hall of Origin: **Arceus** (level 80). If it isn't caught it's back next visit |
| 4 | Manaphy Egg | Hatches into Manaphy. It needs a free spot in your party, or he waits |

Shaymin's tablet doesn't keep your inscription (see [known issues](known-issues.md)).

## One-time Pokémon of the story

| Pokémon | Level | Where | How |
|---|---|---|---|
| Palkia | 47 | Spear Pillar | The story's climax. If you don't catch it, it's back there after your next Hall of Fame entry. |
| Uxie | 50 | Acuity Cavern | After Spear Pillar. Knocked out is gone for good; run, and it's back after your next Hall of Fame entry |
| Azelf | 50 | Valor Cavern | After Spear Pillar. Knocked out is gone for good; run, and it's back after your next Hall of Fame entry |
| Drifloon | 22 | Valley Windworks | Fridays only, once you've freed the Windworks from Team Galactic |
| Spiritomb | 25 | Route 209, Hallowed Tower | Put the Odd Keystone in the tower, then have 32 battles in [the Hideaways](underground.md), and come back |
| Rotom | 15 | Old Chateau, 2F: the TV | At night, after the Hall of Fame with the National Pokédex. One try a day until you catch it |

Dialga is the other version's legendary: it isn't in Lustrous Pearl. The ball with the Lustrous Orb is at Spear Pillar.
